name: Kayaking

seo.title: Kayaking Koh Lanta, Sea Caves and Mangroves | Secret Travel
seo.metaDescription: Kayak trips on Koh Lanta: Talabeng sea cave, island hopping and the Thung Yee Peng mangrove, half day or full day. Lunch and transfer included. From 1,000 THB.

lead: Seven kayak trips from Thung Yee Peng pier, from a mangrove half day to a full day with the sea cave of Koh Talabeng.
promise: Mangroves and the Koh Talabeng sea cave by kayak

facts.label: Start
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng pier, east coast

Mangrove boat trip with lunch, half day
Mangrove kayaking with lunch, half day

Mangrove and fishing park, half day

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Sea cave kayaking and island hopping. Mangrove and monkeys, Koh Aung, then Koh Talabeng by longtail with kayaking and the sea cave. Lunch and a swim on Koh Bubu. 09:00 to 15:00.

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Love kayak, two places. Paddling in the mangrove, then Koh Talabeng by longtail, the sea cave by kayak, lunch on the beach and Koh Phee by longtail. 09:00 to 15:30.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Sea cave kayaking and mangrove. Mangrove forest, longtail to Koh Talabeng and Koh Ung, the sea cave by kayak and the monkey point.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove boat trip with lunch. A longtail around the mangrove forest, then lunch, fruit and a soft drink at the mangrove restaurant.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove kayaking with lunch. You paddle around the mangrove forest, then eat at the mangrove restaurant.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove, Old Town and viewpoint. A longtail through the narrow canals, with monkeys and birds, then lunch and a visit of Lanta Old Town.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove and fishing park. The mangrove by kayak or longtail, lunch at the mangrove restaurant, then the fishing park.

faq.a: For the sea cave, take one of the two full days or the half day with Koh Talabeng. For the mangrove alone, a half day is enough. The fishing park is the one for families who want a bit of everything.
Yes. Lunch, drinks and seasonal fruit come with every trip. The village entrance fee is the only extra.
Yes. Children from 4 to 11 have their own rate.

legacyText.title: Kayaking Koh Lanta, Sea Caves and Mangroves | Secret Travel
intro: Every trip starts at Thung Yee Peng pier, on the east coast. The mangrove is calm, with monkeys and birds. Koh Talabeng has a sea cave you reach by kayak after a short ride on a longtail.
Half days leave in the morning, 9:30 to 12:30, or in the afternoon, 14:00 to 17:00. Full days run from 9:00 to 15:00 or 15:30.
legacyText.cardDescription: Sea caves, mangroves and island hopping by kayak, from a half day to a full day.
goodToKnow: Children from 4 to 11 pay the child rate.
Times can change with the tide and the weather.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The village entrance fee, 40 THB per person, is not included.
legacyText.caption: Sea cave
